subject: Checking on my Quest submission
body: Hi, I submitted my Quest 3 days ago and haven't heard back. Could you share a status update on where I stand?

subject: Need to reschedule tomorrow's interview
body: Hi, something urgent came up and I can't make tomorrow's 10am interview. Can we reschedule to Thursday or Friday afternoon? Sorry for the short notice.

subject: What are the next steps in hiring?
body: Hello, I just finished the screening call. Could you explain the hiring process from here — what comes after the Quest and how long each stage usually takes?

subject: Question about salary range
body: Hi, before I invest more time in the Paid Test, could you share the salary range for the Backend role? I want to make sure we're aligned.

subject: Withdrawing my application
body: Hi team, thanks for your time but I'd like to withdraw from the process. I've accepted another offer. Best of luck with the hiring.

subject: Feedback after rejection?
body: Hi, I got the rejection email yesterday. I put a lot into the Paid Test — could you share one or two points on what to improve? I'd really appreciate it.

subject: Reschedule + quick pay question
body: Hi, can we move Friday's HR call to Monday morning? Also, while I have you — is the Paid Test stage paid, and what's the contract type after? Thanks!

subject: Status of Paid Test review
body: Hello, I submitted the Paid Test last Monday. Just checking if it's been reviewed and when I can expect a decision.

subject: Contract terms question
body: Hi, if I get an offer, is it a full-time permanent contract or a fixed-term contractor agreement? Also, is there a probation period?

subject: Can't upload my deliverables
body: Hi, I'm trying to upload my Quest zip but the page keeps failing with an error. I tried two browsers. Deadline is tomorrow — what should I do?

subject: Interview confirmation and format
body: Hi, confirming my Screen interview on Wednesday. Will it be coding live or just discussion? Anything I should prepare?

subject: Salary + reschedule in one
body: Hello, I need to push today's interview to next week — family emergency. Separately, could you tell me the pay band for the AI Engineer role so I know if it works for me?

subject: When will I hear about screening?
body: Hi, I applied 10 days ago and haven't heard anything. Is my application still under review or should I assume it's closed?

subject: Remote work policy?
body: Hi, is this role fully remote or hybrid? I'm based in Dhaka and want to confirm there are no mandatory onsite weeks.

subject: Start date flexibility
body: Hi, if selected, could I start in 6 weeks instead of 2? I need to serve notice at my current job. Hope that's okay.

subject: Documents needed for HR round
body: Hello, for the HR alignment call, do I need to bring salary slips, ID, or references? Just want to be ready.

subject: Reapply after rejection?
body: Hi, I was rejected at the Quest stage last month. I've since rebuilt the project. Can I reapply, or do I need to wait a cooling period?

subject: Offer deadline extension
body: Hi, thank you for the offer! The deadline to sign is Friday, but I need until Tuesday to decide. Could you extend it by a few days?

subject: Withdrawing due to timing
body: Hi, I like the role but the timing is bad — my finals are next month. Please withdraw me for now. Can I rejoin the next cohort?

subject: Detailed feedback request
body: Hi, I was rejected after the final interview. Could you share specific feedback on my system design round? I want to close the gap before I apply elsewhere.

subject: Reschedule onsite + travel
body: Hi, my onsite is scheduled Monday but my flight was cancelled. Can we shift it to Wednesday? Also, will travel costs be reimbursed?

subject: Part-time or contract possible?
body: Hello, I love the mission but I can only do 30 hours/week right now. Do you offer part-time or contractor terms for this role?

subject: Status update after HR call
body: Hi, I had my HR call last Thursday and was told I'd hear back in 2 days. It's been 5 — any update on the Paid Test invite?

subject: Salary negotiation
body: Hi, the offer is exciting but slightly below my current pay. Is there room to negotiate the base by ~10%? I'm flexible on joining bonus.

subject: Referral question
body: Hi, my friend works at MUST and referred me. Do I still apply normally, or is there a separate referral link I should use?

subject: Reschedule + salary + contract
body: Hi, can we move tomorrow's interview to next Monday? Also two quick questions: what's the salary band, and is it a 6-month contract or permanent? Thanks so much.

subject: Missed interview — sorry!
body: Hi, I'm really sorry — I missed today's interview because of a power cut. Is there any chance to reschedule? It won't happen again.

subject: Background check process?
body: Hi, I got a verbal offer. What does the background check involve and how long does it take? Should I resign now or wait?

subject: Visa sponsorship?
body: Hello, I'm based in Poland — do you sponsor visas or is this remote-only with contractor payroll? Just checking before the next round.

subject: Thank you + next steps
body: Hi, thanks for yesterday's interview — I enjoyed the task discussion. Just wanted to ask what the timeline is for a decision and who I can contact if I have follow-ups.
